title: After 4 months my Auto Battler hit steam - Wizard Tournament
author: RachopDev
selftext:
I'm a big fan of auto battlers like Backpack and Oaken Tower and I wanted to make my own unique version. 

My main development tool was Codex, ChatGPT imagegen, a peppering of Elevenlabs AI audio gen, and purchased assets through itch.

The game went live July 29th and I have sold 150 copies, 300 wish lists and 110 unique demo players. Feedback has been strong and player retention/median play time (2 hours) has exceeded my expectations. But of course I'm running up against the AI haters. I am no artist. I started the project with the intention of hiring artists but I just did not have the budget and settled for 2nd best - AI art. I have been accepted into Auto Battler Fest come November and I'm hoping that provides some opportunity as well. But god help you if you look for support on a game with AI disclosure.

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/4917740/Wizard\_Tournament/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4917740/Wizard_Tournament/)

The demo is practically the full game excluding ranked mode and co-op. If the game interests you DM me and I'd be happy to send you a game key.

comments.author: BoostInGel
comments.body: Couldn't DM you, but happy to receive a key, play it through and leave a review :)

replies.author: RachopDev
replies.body: Sent you a key. Thanks for being interested!
